questions.title: Forest area in China
questions.hint: Forests can be cleared for farms and cattle, or planted on purpose and left to regrow on abandoned farmland.
questions.explanation: It rose to 223.9 in 2023, from 167.1 in 1995. FAO measures forest area in 1990, 2000, 2010, 2015, 2020 and 2025; the years between are straight-line estimates.

questions.title: CO₂ emissions per person in India
questions.hint: Emissions follow how much energy people use, and how much of that energy comes from coal, oil, and gas.
questions.explanation: It rose to 1.7 in 2020, from 0.4 in 1975.

questions.title: Share of workers employed in agriculture in France
questions.hint: Machines and better seeds let fewer farmers feed more people.
questions.explanation: It fell to 3% in 2023, from 5% in 1995.

source.attribution: World Bank, World Development Indicators; International Labour Organization

questions.title: Electoral democracy score of South Korea
questions.hint: South Korea’s first fully competitive presidential election came in 1987.
questions.explanation: It rose to 0.72 in 2023, from 0.25 in 1953.

questions.title: Green cards granted in the United States each year
questions.unitLabel: thousand people granted lawful permanent residence, fiscal years
questions.hint: Immigration laws set quotas by country and category, and they have been rewritten several times.
questions.explanation: It went from 265 in 1960 to a high of 1,536 in 1990, then ended at 707 in 2020. Since the 1960s many people counted here already lived in the US and changed status. The 1989–1992 figures include people legalised under the 1986 amnesty. FY1976 (15 months) is left out.

source.attribution: US Department of Homeland Security, Office of Homeland Security Statistics
